description.p: Cumulas Mail brings your email, calendar, contacts and tasks together in one fast, familiar app. It works with Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com accounts as well as any email provider that supports IMAP.

ul.li: Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com mail, calendar, contacts and To Do
Gmail, Fastmail, iCloud, Yahoo and self-hosted mail over IMAP
New mail within seconds, with notifications you can act on
Reminders for events and tasks, with Snooze, Dismiss and Join
Quick search across all your mail, even offline
Meeting invitations: accept, tentatively accept or decline
Remote images blocked by default to stop email tracking
Passwords and sign-ins protected by your system keyring

description.p: To show new mail as it arrives, IMAP accounts keep a connection open to their mail server. For Microsoft accounts, Microsoft notifies the Cumulas push service (sync.cumulas.co) when the Inbox or calendar changes, and the service passes that on to the app; it never receives a token for the mailbox, and notifications carry no message or event content. The push service can be turned off in Settings, and the Inbox is then checked every 30 seconds. Cumulas Mail has no telemetry.

Closing the window keeps Cumulas Mail running in the background so that new mail and reminders still show up, and it can start at login; both can be changed in Settings. To quit, choose Quit in the main menu or the tray icon's menu.
Cumulas Mail is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.
Microsoft 365 accounts work in more organizations, and Cumulas Mail tells you when an update is ready.

ul.li: When your organization requires an administrator's approval, Cumulas Mail explains why and makes asking easy: copy or email the approval link, open the approval page yourself, or request approval through Microsoft
Try with mail only: where your organization approves mail first, you can sign in now and turn on calendar, contacts and tasks later
Calendar, contacts or tasks that still need permission say so, with Turn on and Ask IT, instead of stopping the whole account
Clear explanations when your organization blocks a sign-in, for example when you aren't assigned to the app or a sign-in rule applies
Updating Cumulas Mail no longer risks signing you out, and permissions approved later are picked up by themselves
A page for IT administrators, flatpak.cumulas.co/admin-consent, explains what Cumulas Mail accesses and how to approve it
When a newer version has been installed, Cumulas Mail offers to restart into it

description.p: Search now covers your whole mailbox.

ul.li: Search finds mail on your computer instantly, then searches every folder on your mail server, however old the messages are
Messages found on the server open, move and flag like any other
Narrow a search with from:, to:, cc:, subject:, body:, has:attachment or "exact phrases"; part of a word finds subjects and senders too
When the Unread or Flagged filter hides results, the list says so and offers to show them all
Searching no longer pauses the window, and first syncs of large mailboxes are much faster
Messages moved between folders on Microsoft 365 no longer go missing until the next full sync

description.p: The first release of Cumulas Mail.

ul.li: Mail, calendar, contacts and tasks for Microsoft 365, Outlook.com and any IMAP/SMTP account
New mail arrives within seconds: IMAP IDLE, and the Cumulas push service for Microsoft accounts
Notifications with quick actions, and reminders for events and tasks
Keeps running in the background, with a tray icon where the desktop shows one
Company signatures from Cumulas Signatures for Microsoft 365 work accounts, and a signature of your own for each account
Your choice of fonts and text size
